newsitem.title: USA: Colonial to buy Great Southern for $22.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Colonial to buy Great Southern for $22.6 mln.

text.p: Colonial BancGroup and Great Southern Bancorp said Friday the companies have signed a definitive agreement to merge Great Southern into Colonial in a deal valued at $22.6 million. The parties had signed a letter of intent on Feb. 20.

Colonial said it will exchange common stock to equal $13.05 per share for Great Southern's outstanding shares, a total value of $20.76 million. In addition, Colonial will assume Great Southern options based on the $13.05 price per share which will bring the total value to approximately $22.6 million.
The transaction will be a tax-free reorganization and will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Completion of the transaction is subject to approval by various regulatory agencies and Great Southern's shareholders.
